Ukraine drone attacks reported in Russia and near Romania

A Ukrainian drone attack in Russia's Saratov region, specifically in Balakovo, resulted in one fatality, according to the regional governor. The attack targeted territory more than 100 kilometers inside Russia. Separately, Romania is investigating a possible drone attack on a tanker within its Black Sea territorial waters. These incidents have intensified scrutiny of Europe's capacity to safeguard shipping and critical infrastructure in the Black Sea.
